row.body: The map's pencil road ends at a barrier mark. A keyring is tied across the fold; its blank tag is polished where a number was rubbed away.
row.title: The route stops at the barrier

sidecar.gloss: A route and a key with no destination remain together.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could tie its gate key to a road map after an access change; the rubbed tag need not mean officials stranded anyone.

row.body: the loose badge and folded road map are tied with cut warning tape. six tally cuts mark the loose badge; only four are crossed through.
row.title: missing count beside the loose badge

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
